response.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entries FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_constructor_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rc.raceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every race, including races with zero constructor result entries. Missing point values are excluded from the sum; a race with no recorded points has a total of zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the average only across races that have at least one constructor result entry.
alternatives.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entries FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_constructor_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rc.raceId LIMIT 10
